title: The LORD Was with Joseph
text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his Egyptian master.

title: In Charge of Everything
text: Potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted him with everything he owned.

title: Blessed Because of Him
text: … the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s household on account of him.

title: How Could I Sin against God?
text: So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?

title: Left His Cloak
text: But leaving his cloak in her hand, he escaped and ran outside.

title: Thrown into Prison
text: So Joseph’s master took him and had him thrown into the prison where the king’s prisoners were confined.

title: Kindness in the Prison
text: … the LORD was with him and extended kindness to him, granting him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.

title: In Charge of the Prisoners
text: And the warden put all the prisoners under Joseph’s care …

title: The Cupbearer and the Baker
text: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he became their personal attendant.

title: Downcast Faces
text: Why are your faces so downcast today?

title: Interpretations Belong to God
text: Don’t interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams.

title: The Dream of the Vine
text: In my dream there was a vine before me, and on the vine were three branches.

title: Restored
text: Pharaoh restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand.

title: Forgotten
text: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot all about him.

title: Blessed in the Fields
text: The LORD’s blessing was on everything he owned, both in his house and in his field.

title: A Personal Attendant
text: Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant.

title: In Irons
text: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons, until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
